message.content: {"rephrased_statement": "Wikinews verified that the activist collective Anonymous launched a coordinated cyber-attack known as 'Operation Baylout' against entities suing The Pirate Bay. This decentralized effort mobilized hundreds of volunteers to jam the websites of the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry and the law firm MAQS. The group also tried to disrupt the fax lines used by the MPAA's anti-piracy office and by prosecuting attorney Monique Wadsted."}
